name: Vampiric Touch

effect.description: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand saps life force. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. You can repeat the attack as an action on later turns.

at_higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Vicious Mockery

effect.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

at_higher_levels: Damage increases by 1d4 at 5th (2d4), 11th (3d4), and 17th (4d4) level.
